modules.title: 常见方法各自对应什么操作

example.label: Network 面板里的请求记录

steps.label: GET：读取
steps.demo:
Network · GET /api/articles/7
方法GET
请求体无
响应文章记录
读取请求已返回
steps.caption: GET 用于安全读取：重复发送不会改变服务器资源的状态。页面有没有显示出想要的结果，仍需单独检查。

steps.label: POST：提交处理
steps.demo:
Network · POST /api/articles
方法POST
请求体title: 夏日游记
响应接口定义的处理结果
steps.caption: POST 表示把请求交给目标资源处理；它可以创建、提交或触发其他处理，不天然等于保存。要看接口约定和实际响应。

steps.label: 405：方法不被允许
steps.demo:
Network · GET /api/articles/7
请求方法GET
响应状态405 Method Not Allowed
下一步核对该资源允许的方法
steps.caption: 405 表示这个资源不允许该请求方法；方法选错也可能得到别的响应，因此要结合接口约定和 Network 里的结果判断。

items.title: GET 是读取
items.text: 地址栏回车、普通链接都是 GET；它被设计为可安全重发，不应产生副作用。

items.title: POST 把请求交给目标资源处理
items.text: 表单提交常用 POST，但 POST 不天然等于保存或新建；按接口约定判断它触发的处理。

items.title: PUT / DELETE 更新与删除
items.text: 按接口约定表达修改和删除；也有接口因兼容性统一用 POST，遵循接口文档。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 405 表示资源不允许该方法，不证明数据是否改变；方法用错也可能收到其他状态码。先对照接口约定，再核对 Network 里的请求和响应。

lessonPractice.title: 一个删除数据的按钮发出 GET 请求，刷新页面时数据又被删了一次。问题出在哪？

options.label: 删除该用 DELETE 或约定 POST，GET 会被重发
options.feedback: 对。GET 是安全读取语义，可被客户端安全重试；会改变资源状态的操作不应借 GET 触发。

options.label: 只在前端加一个确认弹窗就够了
options.feedback: 弹窗拦不住刷新、后退和重试；方法语义错才是根因。

options.label: 把返回的状态码改成 404 就不会重复删了
options.feedback: 状态码只描述结果，改它不改变“GET 会被重发”的事实。

en.title: A delete button sends a GET request, and refreshing the page deletes again. What is the problem?

options.label: Delete should use DELETE or an agreed POST; GET is read-only semantics and can be resent
options.feedback: Correct. GET is for safe reading and may be safely retried; an operation that changes resource state should not be triggered by GET.

options.label: A frontend confirmation dialog is enough
options.feedback: A dialog cannot stop refresh, back, or retry; the method semantics are the root cause.

options.label: Change the returned status code to 404 so it won't delete again
options.feedback: A status code only describes the result; changing it does not change that GET gets resent.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 删除按钮现在发的是 GET 请求，刷新会重复删除。请改成符合语义的方法（DELETE 或接口约定的 POST），并确认刷新页面不会重复触发。改完在 Network 面板核对请求方法和结果。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: The delete button currently sends a GET request, and refresh deletes again. Change it to the semantically correct method (DELETE or the API's agreed POST) and confirm refreshing does not re-trigger it. Verify the method and result in the Network panel afterward.

learning.assumes: You have seen GET and POST, or request records in the Network panel.
learning.outcome: Seeing a request in developer tools, you can say what kind of operation it performs.

modules.title: What operation each common method corresponds to

steps.label: GET: read
steps.demo:
Network · GET /api/articles/7
MethodGET
Request bodyNone
ResponseArticle record
Read request returned
steps.caption: GET is for safe reading: repeating it does not change the server resource. Check separately whether the page shows the result you need.

steps.label: POST: submit for processing
steps.demo:
Network · POST /api/articles
MethodPOST
Request bodytitle: Summer journal
ResponseResult defined by the API
steps.caption: POST sends a request to the target resource for processing. It can create, submit, or trigger work; it does not inherently mean save. Check the API contract and actual response.

steps.label: 405: method not allowed
steps.demo:
Network · GET /api/articles/7
Request methodGET
Response status405 Method Not Allowed
NextCheck methods allowed for this resource
steps.caption: 405 means this resource does not allow that method. A wrong method can produce another response, so judge it alongside the API contract and Network result.

items.title: GET is read
items.text: Address-bar Enter and ordinary links are GET; it is designed to be safely resent and should have no side effects.

items.title: POST submits a request for processing
items.text: Forms commonly use POST, but POST does not inherently mean save or create; check the API contract for the operation it triggers.

items.title: PUT / DELETE update and remove
items.text: Express modification and deletion per the API contract; some APIs use POST uniformly for compatibility—follow the API docs.

modules.title: What it does not tell you
modules.text: A 405 response says the resource does not allow that method; it does not prove whether data changed. A method error may produce another status, so compare the response with the API contract.

distinctions.label: Status code
distinctions.text: The method states the intended operation; the status code states the response result. A resource can return 405 when a method is disallowed, but a wrong method can also produce another response.

distinctions.label: Route
distinctions.text: A route is the URL path identifying which resource; a method is the verb stating what to do to it.
